description: This file defines command palette functionality for the Notesnook project, including command definitions, actions, recent command management, and dynamic command generation based on context.

methods.name: getDefaultCommands
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the list of default commands, including recent, active note, notebook, tag, editor, and static commands.

methods.name: getCommandById
methods.description: Finds and returns a command object by its ID from static commands or editor commands.

methods.name: resolveRecentCommand
methods.description: Resolves a recent command to its full command object, fetching title and icon as needed.

methods.name: getRecentCommands
methods.description: Retrieves the list of recent commands from configuration storage.

methods.name: addRecentCommand
methods.description: Adds a command to the recent commands list, avoiding duplicates and respecting exclusion flags.

methods.name: removeRecentCommand
methods.description: Removes a command from the recent commands list by ID.

methods.name: getActiveNoteCommands
methods.description: Generates commands related to the currently active note, including menu items.

methods.name: getActiveNotebookCommands
methods.description: Generates commands related to the currently active notebook, including menu items.

methods.name: getActiveTagCommands
methods.description: Generates commands related to the currently active tag, including menu items.

methods.name: getEditorCommands
methods.description: Returns commands for editor tabs and undo/redo actions based on current editor session.

methods.name: menuItemToCommands
methods.description: Converts a menu item into one or more command objects, handling nested menus.

methods.name: getCommandTitle
methods.description: Fetches the display title for a recent command, querying database for notes, notebooks, tags, or reminders.
